title: Account Signal Orchestrator & Proposal Accelerator
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: Sales and Customer Success submit many enterprise feature requests as standalone tickets or email threads. The intake surface lacks a consistent way to aggregate related asks, estimate initial effort, and produce a rapid proposal for customers. That causes duplicated scoping work, missed bundling opportunities across accounts, and slower time-to-proposal for high-value deals.

Goal: Build an orchestration helper that consolidates submitted signals, automatically groups related feature asks, surfaces a quick-scope estimate and recommended bundling, and generates a templated proposal draft for Sales/CS to iterate on. The outcome should reduce first-response time, improve bundling capture across accounts, and surface a clear technical handoff to Eng or PMs for committed work.
acceptance_criteria: UI: Sales/CS can select a set of requests and run 'Consolidate' to produce a single consolidated summary within the console.
Auto-clustering: System groups similar requests with configurable thresholds and shows grouping rationale (top 3 matching signals).
Quick-scope: For any consolidated bundle, the tool returns a rough effort band (S/M/L) and recommended priority with rationale based on risk & platform impact.
Proposal draft: Generates a one-page templated proposal (problem, recommended solution, effort band, timeline estimate, risks) exportable to PDF or email copy-paste.
Ownership: Consolidation creates a tracked artifact with clear next-owner and suggested follow-up tasks for PM/Eng and Sales/CS.
Telemetry: Console logs capture bundle counts, time-to-first-proposal, and conversion flags for Sales (accepted/progressed) for analytics.
Permissions: Only Sales/CS and designated intake coordinators can trigger consolidated proposals; audit log entry created for each action.
proposed_solution:
1) Intake aggregator UI: add a 'Consolidate Requests' action to the Enterprise intake queue. 2) Signal clustering engine: lightweight NLP + metadata matching that groups requests by intent, impacted product surface, and customer segment. 3) Heuristics engine: rules that map known signals to an initial effort band (S/M/L) and recommended owner. 4) Proposal generator: templated one-pager using bundles + heuristics results; editable before send. 5) Handoff link: create a linked Linear ticket or update an existing parent ticket with the consolidated summary and suggested scope. 6) Quick analytics: store metrics in the console for tracking bundle effectiveness and deal progress.

We will implement the UI in console-frontend, clustering as a server-side service in ingestion/triage, and use an internal template service to render proposal drafts. Minimal viable version will keep heuristic rules editable in a small admin YAML to enable fast iteration.
notes: Trade-offs: Start with simple rule-based heuristics and small NLP matching to avoid overengineering; plan to iterate to ML clustering if volume justifies it.
Security: proposals may include customer-sensitive excerpts; ensure access control and audit logs are in place before wide rollout.
Scope guardrails: initial release will not auto-commit Engineering work or change SLAs — only produce scoped recommendations and tracked artifacts.
Metrics to watch: reduction in duplicate tickets, median time from intake to first-proposal, and percent of consolidated bundles that lead to accepted proposals.
comments: 2025-02-12 Maya Patel: Initial ticket created after a week of discovery sessions with Sales leadership and three CS managers. Observed frequent manual bundling via spreadsheets.
2025-02-14 Diego Morales: Spoke with Eng triage team; clustering can reuse lightweight embeddings index used in runtime-telemetry. Raised a dependency ENG-8851 for a shared semantic index.
2025-02-16 Evelyn Park (Design): Shared two low-fidelity flows for consolidation UI and proposal editor. Feedback: keep proposal editable and clearly mark autogenerated sections.
2025-02-18 Rajiv Menon (Sales lead): Confirmed Sales would prioritize faster proposal drafts even if initial effort bands are conservative. Suggested export to Google Docs template.

2025-02-20 Diego Morales: Scoped MVP — backend clustering service + console action + simple template renderer. Blocking: need access to historical intake data for tuning; requested dataset export from CS ops.
outreach_plan: Pilot with two AE teams and CS ops for 4 weeks. Run 1: train AE+CS on consolidation flow, collect feedback, iterate on cluster thresholds. Provide one pagers and short how-to videos. Track pilot through weekly check-ins and a quantitative dashboard measuring time-to-proposal and bundle acceptance rate. After pilot, expand to all AE teams with a recorded training session.
